attributes.residual:
BEST RETAINED: UNCHANGED at real 149, insns T190/O191, multiset 7t. No source change kept.

THE MECHANISM, fully decoded from the aligned view, and it accounts for the ENTIRE instruction-count delta plus three of the seven multiset tokens. The target materializes `big` ONCE into a callee-saved register and computes the loop bound at the loop:
    9c:  lis r31,1                <- big = 0x10000, one instruction, r31 live across the retry loop
    ...
    1b4: addic. r6,r31,-23992     <- subtract AND set CR0, at the loop
    1c0: mtctr r6
    1d4: beq ->1e8                <- zero-trip guard consuming that CR0
Ours emits TWO instructions where the target emits one, and then cannot fuse at the loop:
    90:  lis r6,1
    a0:  addi r25,r6,-23992       <- THE HOIST: subtraction folded into the materialization, count parked in r25
    ...
    1b8: cmpwi r25,0              <- separate compare, because the subtraction is 0x118 bytes away
    1bc: mtctr r25
That extra `addi` at 0xa0 IS the whole `ours longer by 1` (191 vs 190). Closing it would deliver count parity 190/190 and take the multiset from 7t to 4t in one move (-1 addi, -1 cmpwi, +1 addic.).

TWO CONDITIONS ARE REQUIRED FOR THE FUSION, and W3 proved they are independent: (1) a SIGNED counter, because `addic.` records a signed comparison and MWCC will not fuse it with the unsigned `cmplwi` that a `u32` counter forces - W3 satisfied this and nothing else moved; (2) the subtraction must remain ADJACENT to the test, which the hoist destroys. Condition 2 is the open one, and it survived four distinct attacks (statement position, definition sink, block scope, and - on the sibling function - scoped opt_lifetimes off).

WHY volatile IS THE WRONG INSTRUMENT HERE, unlike loadGauntletSave: the target keeps `big` in REGISTER r31 and does no reload, so qualifying `big` volatile would force an `lwz` the target does not have. The sibling's cure is specifically not transferable, which is a live instance of discipline 1 (diagnosis transfers, prescriptions rot).

NEXT UNTRIED HYPOTHESIS (mandatory step 1 for the next lane, per discipline 10b): every probe so far tried to move the SUBTRACTION to the loop. Try instead to make the subtraction non-hoistable by attacking its OPERAND - `big` is assigned exactly one compile-time constant and read exactly once, which is precisely the shape MWCC folds. Give `big` a second reaching definition that the optimizer cannot prove equal (for example, assign it in both arms of an existing branch that already exists in the retry loop, rather than once before it), so `big - 23992` stops being loop-invariant and must be computed after the join. If the hoist dies, W3's signed retype should be reinstated in the same edit, because BOTH conditions must hold simultaneously and W3 alone was measured inert - probing them separately again would waste the budget the same way.

SMALLER REMAINING CLUSTERS, not yet worked: a store-placement reorder at T@24/O@24-28 (`stw`), an `lis`/`addi` pair at T@90-a0, an `li`-vs-`addi` at T@168-174, and a trailing `li` at T@290 - together the remaining 4 multiset tokens.
